lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: pool lockMode value set by onlyGuardian before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: pool lockMode value observed after rebaseOraclePack executes

rebase_executed.meaning: rebaseOraclePack has executed and modified the oracle pack

pool_continual_attack_exposure.meaning: pool is exposed to continual attack that onlyGuardian's lockMode=3 was meant to prevent

assumptions: rebaseOraclePack is the operation that runs after the guardian sets lockMode.
lockMode is a single observable field on the pool.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call rebaseOraclePack or whether the caller is unauthorized; the trigger is modeled only as rebaseOraclePack having executed.
Report does not give the concrete transaction ordering or timing of the rebase relative to the guardian's lock beyond the before/after checkpoints.

limitations: The impact is modeled as a grounded Boolean exposure flag; the report gives no numeric definition of continual attack exposure.
The correspondence relation checks lockMode equality across the rebase; the report does not specify the exact post-rebase value beyond it being modified.
